summary: Tracks changes made to site profiles, including user actions, date of changes, and affected fields. Supports querying by site and session agency.
purpose: To provide a historical record of changes to site profiles for auditing and tracking purposes.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Set stored procedure for database query.
Add necessary parameters like SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Read and map results to SiteProfileHistory objects.
Return list of site profile history entries.

calculations: Format ActionDate to a short date string for display.
system_behavior: Display the name and contact details of the user who made changes.
